The '''Tatooine Space Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].

==History==
After the loss of [[Station-Star 1]], the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] Space Station became primary space station for the system. The space station was not the friendliest one in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], but for the right price they could be persuaded to provide emergency repairs. The station was notorious for clearing anyone to land at any of Tatooine's [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]] without even the most basic security protocols in place.

The station manager would also give missions to [[Smugglers' Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], privateers, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] so that they could earn landing access to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].

Pilots of all factions could also find [[Kelen Wordkal]] near the Tatooine Space Station for additional pilot work.
